_about: Everyday comparisons and per-person baselines used to put footprints in context. The impact model itself comes from the ecologits package.
_ladders_help: Each indicator is shown in the largest step whose size fits at least once. size is in the indicator's base unit (Wh, L, gCO2e). percent: show values below 1 as a percentage.

steps.source: Typical smartphone battery ~4,000 mAh x 3.85 V = 15 Wh
Heating 1 L of water from 20 to 100 C = 4.186 kJ/kg.K x 80 K = 93 Wh, ~100 Wh with kettle losses
A 40-60 C wash cycle ~1 kWh (EU energy label figures for washing machines)
Average EU household ~3,525 kWh/year = ~9.7 kWh/day (Eurostat 2024: 712.5 TWh household electricity, nrg_bal_c, over 202.2 million households, lfst_hhnhtych)
Average EU household ~3,525 kWh/year (Eurostat 2024: 712.5 TWh household electricity, nrg_bal_c, over 202.2 million households, lfst_hhnhtych)
Average petrol car ~162 gCO2e/km (UK DESNZ 2026 conversion factors, 0.16152 kg/km)
Average petrol car ~162 gCO2e/km (UK DESNZ 2026 conversion factors, 0.16152 kg/km)
One economy seat London to New York one-way, ~0.8 tCO2e incl. non-CO2 effects and fuel supply (UK DESNZ 2026 long-haul economy: 0.117 kg/pkm with RF + 0.025 well-to-tank, x 5,570 km = 0.79 t)

_person_day_help: One person's share of a day, per indicator, in the indicator's base unit (Wh, L, g CO2e). Electricity and greenhouse gases per person come from data/countries.json (Our World in Data, refreshed by scripts/update_factors.py) for the world and for the country set as compare_country in the config. Water footprints and the 1.5 °C budget are fixed, sourced values below. Shown as a percentage of one person-day, or as person-days once past 100%.

long.energy: the %s daily electricity generation per person
long.carbon: the %s daily greenhouse-gas emissions per person (incl. land use)

WLD.long: the world-average daily water footprint per person (all water used to make what one consumes: food, goods and household water, incl. rainwater in crops and water needed to dilute pollution)
WLD.source: Global average water footprint of consumption 1996-2005: 1,385 m3/yr per capita (Mekonnen & Hoekstra 2011, National Water Footprint Accounts, UNESCO-IHE Value of Water Research Report 50) / 365 days

NLD.long: the Dutch-average daily water footprint per person (all water used to make what one consumes, at home or abroad: food, goods and household water, incl. rainwater in crops and water needed to dilute pollution)
NLD.source: Water footprint of Dutch consumption 1996-2005: ~2,300 m3/yr per capita (Van Oel, Mekonnen & Hoekstra 2009, Ecological Economics 69(1)) / 365 days

carbon_budget.label: 1.5 °C budget
carbon_budget.source: 1.5 °C-compatible lifestyle target for 2030: 2.5 tCO2e per person per year (IGES/Aalto, 1.5-Degree Lifestyles, 2019) / 365 days

_review_help: as_of: the year a figure's source refers to; review_years: how often to re-check it (null = a physical quantity that doesn't go stale). scripts/stale_factors.py lists what is due; a yearly workflow opens an issue.
